poll.source_locator: Florida statewide page (Oct 30-31 poll), Full results, U.S. Senate: Ashley Moody (R) 48%, Angie Nixon (D) 45%, Prefer not to answer 4%, Undecided 2%, Neil J. Gillespie (NPA) 1%, Did not vote in this race 1%, Someone else 1%
poll.notes: New fresh statewide wave, distinct from the Oct 20-23 RedBox Florida poll already in polls.csv (n=4,832). other = Gillespie 1 + someone else 1; Prefer not 4 and Did not vote 1 not folded in. Page prints whole numbers only. Released November 1, 2026; text-to-web in English and Spanish (278 Spanish). The pollster states both new weighting targets (party, Oct 31; 2024 vote, Nov 1) were set after fieldwork and after seeing earlier results, and that its Oct 20-23 interviews re-run through the new model give Moody +4. Sensitivity table on the page: with the certified 2024 result as target Moody 48, Nixon 44; with no 2024-vote target Nixon +4. Found on the AFWH polling index (not yet on Wikipedia/270toWin at fetch time).

pollster.weighting_quote: So we set the 2024 target to the records-based estimate for this year's projected voters (42.7% Harris), then adjusted it for that measured misremembering, giving 44.0%. Both inputs come from outside our poll.
